data.overview: Pin Up Secret is a French skincare brand founded in 2011 whose evidence base in the fetched sources consists entirely of its own marketing pages (pinup-secret.com and pinup-secret.fr). These company-published sources make quality/efficacy and natural-sourcing claims centered on goat milk, but no independent assessments, legal matters, or third-party verification of the brand appear in the fetched sources.

claims.claim: Pin Up Secret says its formulas are simple, effective, and built on the quality of its raw materials to deliver visible results.
claims.quote: the volonté de créer et proposer des cosmétiques qui sont basés sur la qualité des matières premières. Des formulations simples et efficaces qui sublimeront les peaux de toutes les femmes.

claims.claim: Pin Up Secret says its goat milk comes from its own organic farm where goats are raised without fertilizers, pesticides, or hormones.
claims.quote: Each bar is handcrafted by our in-house farmers, who raise and nurture our goats without the use of fertilizers, pesticides, or hormones.
